# WNY Injury Lawyers

> > Personal injury law firm Andrews, Bernstein & Maranto, PLLC serving Buffalo, Western New York, and surrounding counties with comprehensive legal representation for accident victims.

WNY Injury Lawyers provides legal guidance across motor vehicle accidents, workplace injuries, product liability, and elder care negligence throughout Erie County, Genesee County, and Western New York. The firm specializes in navigating New York State's no-fault insurance system and comparative negligence laws.

- Personal injury claims in Buffalo and Western New York
- New York State no-fault insurance law
- Comparative negligence and liability
- Motorcycle accident injuries and claims
- Whiplash and soft tissue injuries

- Product liability and defective products
- Nursing home negligence documentation
- Statute of limitations for injury claims
- Brain injury and TBI cases
- Erie County and Genesee County jurisdiction
- Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI)

- Andrews, Bernstein & Maranto, PLLC representation
